tracks.title: 搖搖板
tracks.mood: flirty, teasing, rocking sway, playful payback
tracks.subject: Two childhood playmates meet at thirty-five by their Wong Tai Sin estate seesaw: at seven she was the heavy one who kept him dangling until he said please; now he outweighs her, she hangs in the air, and his 'please' is asking her to dinner.
